attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, capped at the deadline.

opening.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Corvid Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Corvid Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning Corvid Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: I cannot continue; please use the mobile app or a branch.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not take a promise.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Please say the month as a word.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, just to be sure: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Do not say why you are calling to a third party; say nothing beyond the opening sentence and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; hello, go ahead, who is this do not. Answer customer questions first; the following ask counts as the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: Callback must be on the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive and later than now; a time today counts as outside the window. If the offer is outside, ask once more, then close not_reached/no_callback without scheduling.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A callback must be on the **next business day**, still between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account

extra_rules.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; read numeric-only dates as day, month, year. Send four digits for phone_last4.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped hint retry does not count as a wrong answer; ask the customer to say the month as a word.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers do not state the debt; tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch; close not_verified/failed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer declines the questions, explain once they protect the account; asking what the call is about counts as declining; a second refusal or such question closes not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after all questions pass; name the product in words, state past_due and days_late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day, not after the deadline. Weekend/holiday within deadline: offer the next business day. Date after deadline: say the latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Vague period: ask once for the exact day; if none, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Ask the full past-due amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. If full is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: Customer-proposed amount from floor to full is accepted; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; non-acceptance is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount proposed by the customer is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a plain no to paying today is a flat refusal. Do not repeat a refused offer; when attempts are used up close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: Illness, death in family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer support team; accept -> transfer queue hardship and close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. If the customer names a date or amount, still record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask for confirmation; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date or amount, re-check and read back again.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true; on failure retry once, then say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: I already paid: say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear

extra_rules.statement: Dispute (not mine, never had product, product closed/paid off in past): do not argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Request for new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Request for a human: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to general and close transferred/human, before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

extra_rules.statement: Scam question: tell them to verify by phoning Corvid Bank's customer service number, and continue. Robot/AI question: say you are the digital assistant and continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: tell them they can verify the call by phoning Corvid Bank's customer service number, and continue

extra_rules.statement: Unanswerable question: say you do not have that information; do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close no_promise/refused; before verification close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

extra_rules.statement: close_call is exactly once, last tool call; thank and say goodbye before it. If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Brief does not state a product id pattern; product_id_format left empty.
A vague date has no exact day. Ask once for the day. If there is still none, offer the deadline from the facts.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks for a new payment plan, a restructuring, or lower instalments. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card, and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.
examples: The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card, and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.
Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.
If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks to speak to a person. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
examples: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Corvid Bank's digital assistant and continue.

extra_rules.statement: The customer names a hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
examples: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `hardship` and close as `transferred` / `support`.
